entities.summary: Andreas Markos Antonopoulos is a British-Greek early Bitcoin advocate, tech entrepreneur, and author. He is a host on the Speaking of Bitcoin podcast and a teaching fellow for the M.Sc. Digital Currencies at the University of Nicosia.
